argument: pin each Newton disc to its scan zero: r_scan < disc radius puts scan zero k inside disc k; interval-Newton uniqueness makes it THE zero of disc k; scan zeros are pairwise distinct and, by the census count, exhaustive. Starting-disc overlap is irrelevant.
conclusion: every zero of zeta with 0 < t <= 5000 is simple and satisfies |Re rho - 1/2| <= 9.489e-77
